source_documents.title: Customized Tuning of Aggregation-Induced Emission of a Napthalimide Dye by Surfactants and Cyclodextrin

conditions_studied: surfactant solutions below and above CMC

reference_evidence_units.quote: The changes observed in the excitation spectrum of the dye compared to its absorption spectra in water in presence of the surfactants above their micellar concentration reveals the transformation of the H-aggregates of the dye to the monomeric form.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu
reference_evidence_units.statement: H-aggregates convert to monomers in micelles.

reference_evidence_units.quote: A clear isoemissive point at 554 nm shows a clear transformation
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu
reference_evidence_units.statement: Isoemissive conversion between aggregate (486 nm) and monomer (~600 nm) bands.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Since the aggregates are blue shifted with respect to the monomers in the case of both ionic as well as non-ionic surfactants
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu

reference_evidence_units.quote: This can be explained by the presence of high dipole moment of DMN-Bu due to an intramolecular charge transfer nature of the dye.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu
